card.name: REMS and FDA MedWatch reporting references
card.fires_on: The last piece of a REMS program name (e.g. the end of a brand name before REMS) or the '.gov' ending of the FDA MedWatch web address. It also fires on the bracket right after 'REMS'.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward the word 'safety', as in a safety program or safety reporting.
card.plain: It marks spots where the label names a safety program or the FDA reporting site, where a word like 'safety' is likely next.
